title: On the universality of soft emission beyond the next-to-soft order
summary: The Low-Burnett-Kroll theorem (extended to non-abelian gauge theory) states that the tree-level emission amplitude of a soft gauge boson from an arbitrary hard process can be expressed in terms of the non-radiative amplitude including the next-to-soft term. Reformulating the soft theorem in the framework of an on-shell effective theory leads to a natural gauge-invariant split into an external and internal emission process to any order in the soft expansion.
